title.zh: 移民（国际海洋法法庭——第 6 条豁免）命令 2023
title.en: Immigration (International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea — Exemption from Section 6) Order 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Immigration (International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea — Exemption from Section 6) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 5 May 2023.

heading.en: Exemption from section 6(1) and (2) of Act

text.en:
3.—(1) Subject to sub‑paragraph (2), each of the following persons is exempt from section 6(1) and (2) of the Act if that person enjoys diplomatic immunity or similar legal status:
(a)an expert appointed under article 289 of the Convention;
(b)an agent, a counsel or an advocate before the Tribunal or a Chamber of the Tribunal;
(c)a witness, an expert, or any person performing a mission in Singapore by order of the Tribunal or a Chamber of the Tribunal.
(2) The exemption from section 6(1) of the Act conferred by sub‑paragraph (1) —
(a)does not apply to any person who is a permanent resident of Singapore; and
(b)is subject to regulation 39 of the Immigration Regulations (Rg 1).
(3) The exemption under sub‑paragraph (1) does not affect the exemptions under the Immigration (Exemption from Section 6) Order (O 1).
4. The burden of proof that any person is a person to whom this Order applies lies on that person.
5. Nothing in this Order is to be construed to exempt any person from examination under section 24, 25, 25A or 26 of the Act, as the case may be.
